fix: Borrow instead of cloning the whole ComponentThemeData (it carries an Option<ButtonStyle> and about 30 fields): `let default = ComponentThemeData::default(); let inherited = inherited.unwrap_or(&default);`. The later field reads (`inherited.label_color.or(..)`, `inherited.minimum_size.map(..)`) work unchanged on a reference because the fields are Copy Options. The same pattern repeats in NavigationDrawer::build_with_theme at line 416; fix both together.

Iterate the borrowed slice instead of cloning the Vec first: `children.extend(self.children.iter().cloned());`. The current form allocates a temporary Vec<Widget> that is dropped right after the extend. Also size the vector up front: `let mut children = Vec::with_capacity(self.children.len() + self.destinations.len() + 1);` (line 420).
The final child count is known up front (leading + destinations.len() + trailing), so write `let mut children = Vec::with_capacity(self.destinations.len() + 2);`.
